info.title: Celeb DF (v2)
info.subtitle: Credit: https://cse.buffalo.edu/~siweilyu/celeb-deepfakeforensics.html
info.description: Celeb-DF (v2) dataset contains real and DeepFake synthesized videos having similar visual quality on par with those circulated online. The Celeb-DF (v2) dataset is greatly extended from our previous Celeb-DF (v1), which only contains 795 DeepFake videos. To date, Celeb-DF includes 590 original videos collected from YouTube with subjects of different ages, ethic groups and genders, and 5639 corresponding DeepFake videos.
